title: Gallery configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.GalleryAPI.Create, parsed. Every property is required, as the platform always sends them all: an omitted one is not defaulted and stays undefined at runtime. A default is the value an invalid one falls back to. Generated by scripts/docs-ai-generator/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

ItemsGap.description: Gap between items as a framework space name (none, xs, s, base, m, l, xl, xxl), mapped to --space-*.

RowItemsDesktop.description: Number of items per row on desktop.

RowItemsPhone.description: Number of items per row on phones.

RowItemsTablet.description: Number of items per row on tablets.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
